subject.title: Feature: preserve completed progress draft in Telegram progress mode

question: Should Telegram progress mode gain a default-off option that preserves the full completed progress draft, including checklist-style state, while sending the final answer as a separate normal message?
rationale: Current main intentionally collapses the draft into a compact summary and root policy treats new channel config/lifecycle behavior as compatibility-sensitive, so automation should not choose the permanent UX/API shape.

options.title: Accept default-off full preservation
options.body: Add a documented Telegram-owned keep-on-complete or finalization option while preserving the current one-line collapse summary as the default.

options.title: Keep current summary behavior
options.body: Leave Telegram progress mode as final answer plus compact activity digest and decline full completed-draft preservation for now.

options.title: Fold into structured progress cards
options.body: Defer the Telegram-only option into a cross-channel structured progress-card design that can model checklist state consistently.

recommendation.title: Accept default-off full preservation
recommendation.body: Add a documented Telegram-owned keep-on-complete or finalization option while preserving the current one-line collapse summary as the default.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest recent current-main history on the Telegram progress summary and collapse behavior this decision would change.
